title: PERSIST: Who-What-When Memory Across Sessions for Full-Duplex Spoken Dialogue
title_zh: PERSIST：跨会话全双工语音对话中的“谁-什么-何时”记忆
abstract_en: Modern voice assistants may be shared by multiple users and should be able to answer questions about earlier conversations such as "When did I originally plan to leave?" or adapt their behavior to individual users based on past interactions. This requires more than retrieving a topically similar passage: the assistant must identify the current speaker, recover the relevant past state, and distinguish it from later revisions. We present PERSIST, a persistent memory system for multi-session, multi-speaker spoken dialogue that explicitly models Who, What, and When. PERSIST structures cross-session histories into readable event records and retrieves them with a 3W joint scoring mechanism that combines semantic content, acoustic speaker identity, and temporal state. For real-time full-duplex interaction, PERSIST further reuses intermediate representations from the dialogue backbone, avoiding query-audio re-encoding and reducing retrieval latency from 578.42 ms to 7.03 ms. We also introduce SpokenTrace, a diagnostic benchmark that factorizes evaluation along memory tasks and speaker-query types, exposing failures in recall, speaker attribution, and temporal-state tracking. On SpokenTrace, PERSIST achieves 85.08% end-to-end task accuracy and improves all-support EM@3 from 49.01% with BGE-large to 82.10%.
abstract_zh: 现代语音助手可能由多个用户共享，并需要回答“我最初计划何时出发”等跨会话问题，或依据历史交互适应不同用户。此类能力不仅需要检索主题相似内容，还要识别当前说话人、恢复相关历史状态，并区分后续修改。本文提出 PERSIST，一种面向多会话、多说话人语音对话的持久记忆系统，显式建模 Who、What 和 When。PERSIST 将跨会话历史组织为可读事件记录，并通过 3W 联合评分机制融合语义内容、声学说话人身份和时间状态进行检索。针对实时全双工交互，系统复用对话骨干网络的中间表示，避免对查询音频重复编码，将检索延迟从 578.42 ms 降至 7.03 ms。作者进一步提出 SpokenTrace 诊断基准，沿记忆任务和说话人-查询类型分解评测，揭示召回、说话人归因及时间状态跟踪方面的失败。在 SpokenTrace 上，PERSIST 达到 85.08% 的端到端任务准确率，并将 all-support EM@3 从 BGE-large 的 49.01% 提升至 82.10%。
key_points_zh: 提出 PERSIST，通过可读事件记录和 3W 联合评分统一建模语义内容、说话人身份与时间状态。
面向多用户共享语音助手，能够区分当前说话人、恢复历史状态，并识别后续修订与原始计划之间的差异。
复用对话骨干网络的中间表示，避免查询音频重复编码，将检索延迟由 578.42 ms 降至 7.03 ms。
提出 SpokenTrace 基准，分别诊断记忆召回、说话人归因和时间状态跟踪能力。
PERSIST 在 SpokenTrace 上取得 85.08% 端到端准确率，all-support EM@3 达到 82.10%，显著优于 BGE-large 的 49.01%。

llm_assessment.comment: A strong realtime spoken-agent memory system that jointly handles speaker identity, temporal state, and cross-session retrieval with substantial latency reduction and a diagnostic benchmark.
llm_assessment.comment_zh: 该工作将说话人身份、时间状态和跨会话记忆统一到实时语音智能体中，并显著降低检索延迟、提供诊断基准。
